claims.statement: Tom Allen's interference with the Daly-McManus prize fight drew a protest from Deacon Hovser's paper, which said the fight should go on.
claims.excerpt: the interference of Mr. Tom ALLnn with a prize-fight

quotes.speaker: Deacon Hovser's paper
quotes.text: it would bea pity to stop the Daly-McManus fight when both the principals are ready to proceed. Letthe mill go on, by all means.

notes: The protest is quoted from Deacon Hovser's paper, which is not named as the Globe-Democrat in the text; the hint's paper name is unconfirmed. No bout of Allen's is described. The paper calls Allen a reformed prize-fighter, but the line is OCR-broken (him-cel?, refoemed) and too short to quote as a claim.
